evals.name: campaign-recap
evals.prompt: we just wrapped an instagram reels campaign for a d2c skincare brand. 18 creators, 3 weeks, 40+ reels, 2.1 million views, total spend was 92,000 INR. write me a tweet about it
evals.expected_output: A lowercase stat-stacked tweet in the campaign-recap shape, ending on a cliffhanger question or takeaway, with INR + USD conversion

evals.name: hot-take
evals.prompt: just watched another ai startup launch video, 3 minutes of cinematic drone shots and epic music before they even showed the product. i genuinely think simple screen-recorded demos win now. tweet this take
evals.expected_output: A short aphoristic hot-take tweet with stacked lines, minimal punctuation, one deliberate period at most

evals.name: casual-win
evals.prompt: our agency just signed its first US client!! write a tweet, keep it chill, i don't want it to be cringe or braggy
evals.expected_output: A one-or-two line casual win-share tweet, lowercase, zero ceremony, at most one self-aware emoji
